method.value: Determine edge-on status from GZ2 or NSA inclination; use GZ2/HyperLEDA agreement for bars and inspect SDSS RGB images for disagreements or missing classifications

evidence.quote: For each galaxy in the sample, we first use GZ2 to determine whether the galaxy is edge-on (cite: willett13).

method.value: Fit six surface-brightness profiles with 3D KINMS cubes; select the lowest-BIC converged model

evidence.quote: For each object in ALMaQUEST, we fit six different surface brightness profiles: an exponential disc, an exponential disc + central hole, a Gaussian ring, two exponential discs, an exponential disc + a Gaussian ring and two Gaussian rings
The best-fit model is the one that produces the lowest BIC, whereby more complex surface brightness models are penalised for larger parameter spaces

key_parameters.value: Disc peak brightness and scale width; ring peak brightness, mean radius and width; x0, y0, V_sys, PA, inclination, total flux, V_max, R_turn and σ_gas

evidence.quote: Each exponential disc has two free parameters describing the peak surface brightness ($F_{\rm exp,\ peak}$) and scale width ($R_{\rm exp}$)

each Gaussian ring has three free parameters describing the peak surface brightness ($F_{\rm gauss,\ peak}$), the mean radius of the ring ($R_{\rm gauss}$) and the width of the ring ($\sigma _{\rm gauss}$).
The total number of parameters used in each model varies depending on the surface brightness model used, with 10 being the minimum and 14 the maximum.

key_parameters.value: First component peak flux fixed to 1; second component varies relative to it

evidence.quote: in one-component profiles the peak flux is fixed to 1 and in two-component profiles the peak flux of the first component in fixed to 1, while the other is left to vary relative to the first.

key_parameters.value: BIC = k log(n) − 2 log(L_hat); n is signal spaxels in the cube

fitting.value: Initial least-squares minimisation; adaptive-step MCMC Gibbs sampler; uniform priors with physically motivated boundaries; 100,000 steps, 25 workers

evidence.quote: implements a Python Markov chain Monte Carlo (MCMC) Gibbs sampler with adaptive stepping
Before fitting each model with MCMC, we fit an initial model using a least-squares minimisation.
The MCMC is set with uniform priors with physically-motivated boundaries and run using 100,000 steps with 25 workers.

validation.value: Reject parameters whose 16th–84th percentile uncertainty width exceeds half the explored range; converged best-fit model found for every object

evidence.quote: We reject models that have fit parameters with uncertainties (defined as the width between the $\rm 16^{th}$ and $\rm 84^{th}$ percentiles of the probability distribution function) larger than half the size of the parameter range explored
We successfully find a converged best-fit model for each object in the sample.

method.value: Add radial_barflow to the selected surface-brightness model; refit with MCMC and compare BIC with the no-flow model

referee_caveats_inferred: The acknowledgements print 2011.0.01234.S, inconsistent with the four programmes listed in the data section; its role requires clarification.
The supplied text contains image links but no readable flowchart contents or per-galaxy model table, limiting reconstruction of classifications.
The text reports 19 flow detections, while its rounded morphological fractions and counts do not transparently reproduce that total.
Failure to reject a KS null hypothesis does not establish identical gas-fraction distributions.
Several subset comparisons are made without a stated multiple-testing treatment.
Model selection and flow detection may depend on unreported likelihood weighting and correlated-voxel treatment.
Associations between flows and SFE do not establish causal quenching or directly measure shear stabilization.
The printed central stellar-density threshold of ≈8.25 M_⊙ pc^-2 needs clarification about whether a logarithm is intended.
The arctan equation approaches V_max asymptotically, whereas the prose describes R_turn as where V_max occurs.
Noise-degradation results are reported without a stated ensemble of independent random realizations.
